description: This is a test class for the CapabilitiesDeserializer component of an Android client, testing its ability to parse JSON responses representing server capabilities and versions related to Nextcloud Notes.

classes.name: CapabilitiesDeserializerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for CapabilitiesDeserializer, testing various scenarios of parsing server capabilities JSON.

methods.name: testDefaultWithoutApiVersion
methods.description: Tests deserialization of capabilities JSON without the api_version property; expects default parsing and color values.

methods.name: testDefaultWithApiVersion
methods.description: Tests deserialization with api_version property as a list; verifies correct handling.

methods.name: testDefaultWithInvalidApiVersion
methods.description: Tests handling of invalid api_version data type (string instead of list); expects fallback handling.

methods.name: testRealisticSample
methods.description: Tests deserialization with a comprehensive, realistic JSON sample containing multiple capabilities and nested properties.

methods.name: testDirectEditing
methods.description: Checks if direct editing capability detection works based on JSON properties.

methods.name: testSharingDisabled
methods.description: Verifies the correct parsing of server capabilities when sharing features are disabled.
